purpose: Public health research on blood pressure in hypertension.
question: What is the mean latest systolic blood pressure of patients with hypertension, by 10-year age band?
definitions: Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Use the latest systolic blood pressure (LOINC 8480-6) per patient.
Report per 10-year age band: mean systolic blood pressure.
